_doc: Which node pins carry a *name* that refers to a named thing. Keyed by numeric node ID (shell id). Extend via data/overlay.json ('refRules') or edit here. pin/valuePin/triggerPin/loopPin = '<kind>:<shellIndex>' with kind one of in_param/out_param. valuePin (optional) is the pin whose type labels the variable's datatype. triggerPin (optional) is a boolean 'Trigger Event' pin; triggerDefault (with triggerPin) is its value when the file stores no pin (pins are stored only when edited): true for both Set nodes; loopPin (optional) is a boolean 'Loop' pin (Start Timer only).

eventNodesWithNameOutput._doc: These trigger nodes fire for ANY variable/timer; the name only appears as an OUTPUT pin, so they are reported as a listener for any name.

eventNamePins._doc: Shell out_param index of the name output on each event node above (all four are 'Variable Name'/'Timer Name', index 2 – checked against data/nodes.json by test/resolution.test.mjs). Used by the listener analysis; an event listed above but missing here stays a plain any-name listener.
